key_insight: OptiAgent turns a natural-language operations research problem into a solver-ready formulation and executable code using iterative multi-agent refinement with built-in self-correction.
engineering_relevance: The framework can reduce manual modeling effort for optimization engineers while improving transparency and auditability of mathematical model generation.
method: Uses dedicated agents to extract decision variables, constraints, and other problem structure from text.
Applies multi-loop validation with four feedback mechanisms to catch misinterpretation, structural defects, mathematical inconsistencies, validation failures, and code errors.
Prioritizes mathematical modeling before code generation so the formulation can be refined iteratively.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art results on 3 of 4 benchmarks spanning LP, MILP, and nonlinear programming, with strong performance on the remaining dataset.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable multi-agent coordination and validation, so complex or ambiguous problem statements may still require human review.
paper_title: OptiAgent: End-to-End Optimization Modeling via Multi-Agent Iterative Refinement
